label: exploratory_post_hoc
label_reason: the final523 test IDs were already used for the confirmatory comparison; this run adds one profile after the primary outcome was known. It cannot change the confirmatory label, the LED choice, or any earlier table, and it is not a model-selection run
decision_source: user, 2026-10-31: plan 261031-2136-rq2-summarization-completion phase 2, run local on a T4 (no API, no data sent to a third party)
question: how does the text-summarization model family used by the application (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, one prompt, no chunking) compare with LED ngram3 and BART on the same final523 IDs, the same delivered-word cap, and the same scorers
scope_limits: text stage only: the application also feeds OCR text and object counts and asks for Vietnamese structured output; this run measures none of that
the weights are the 4-bit AWQ build of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, not the unquantized model reached through OpenRouter in the application; the result describes the identity below only
the application's fallback chain (Llama, Groq) is not used; a failed call is a failure row, never a call to another model
creator-abstract agreement and sentence-level source support are not factuality percentages

engine.pin_note: chosen before any generated output; the first Colab attempt (2026-11-01) failed at model load with AttributeError: Qwen2Tokenizer has no attribute all_special_tokens_extended, because vllm 0.11.0 left Colab's transformers 5.x in place; transformers is therefore pinned to 4.57.1 as well (a mechanical engine fix: no output existed and the prompt is untouched). The notebook records the installed versions in the receipt. If it still cannot run on the Colab T4, stop and report; do not switch engine silently
engine.memory_note: second mechanical fix (2026-11-01, still no output): the dry run died with torch.OutOfMemoryError (a 914 MiB mask allocation with 0.5 GiB free of 14.56 GiB) while prefilling 7,573 tokens at once, so gpu_memory_utilization is lowered from 0.9 to 0.8 and the prefill chunk from vLLM's 8192 to 2048 tokens; prompt, model, decoding and context length are unchanged
engine.projection: after 5 batches (20 records) of a fixed spread order of the 523 IDs; the projection is compared with the ceiling

prompt.language: English (TIB talks and abstracts are English)
prompt.system: You write abstracts of conference talks.
prompt.length_rationale: 110 words is the median reference length of the train split (7,276 train references: p25 66, median 110, p75 185, p95 346 words); no validation or test reference was used
prompt.variants: none; one prompt, never reworded after any output is seen
prompt.applied_via: the model's chat template (system and user messages), no few-shot examples, no reference text

decoding.note: greedy decoding; vLLM batching can still change floating-point order, so determinism across sessions is not claimed

inputs.bundle: tib-final523-scoring-261024-v1.zip (private); sources and references are read from scoring_outputs.jsonl, the 523 distinct test record IDs
inputs.source_text: the normalized transcript exactly as given to LED and BART, never truncated: a prompt longer than max_model_len minus max_new_tokens is a failed row (prompt_too_long), not a truncated one
inputs.dry_run: optional, 8 IDs taken in sorted order from the selection300 (validation) bundle; prints lengths, finish reasons and word counts only. Only mechanical faults (template, token limits, stop tokens) may be fixed after it; wording of the prompt may not

output_rows.schema: same fields as scoring_outputs.jsonl of the final523 scoring bundle (private file, never in the repository)
output_rows.delivered_summary: select_delivered(raw, 350 words), the contract cap used for every final523 profile
output_rows.views: S, M, L = 60, 120, 240 word sentence prefixes (tib_budget_views.build_views)

generation_status.completed_with_warning: any warning in `warnings`: finish_reason length (no terminal end-of-sequence), a repeated 4-gram (>= 3 times), or a forced word-boundary cut; kept and scored like LED outputs with the same flags
generation_status.failed: exception, empty output or prompt_too_long; stays in the denominator as NULL and is never scored as zero

output_rows.failure_retry: prompt_too_long is final; any other failed row is generated again on the next run and appended again (a record can appear twice in the private file; the last line wins and the scoring notebook keeps one row per record); a torn last line is cut off the file on resume; the run stops after 2 consecutive batches without a single generated row

metrics.rouge: rouge-score 0.1.2, use_stemmer true, rouge1/rouge2/rougeL F1 against the creator abstract, delivered summary; byte-identical configuration to scorer v2 (reproduces all 2,088 stored final523 ROUGE-L values with maximum difference 0 on 2026-10-31); computed on the delivered (350-word) summary only
metrics.bertscore: scorer v2 (xlm-roberta-large layer 17, window extension) is available only through the formal scorer venv and assets of the final523 scoring bundle; it is a separate optional step and is not in the generation or scoring notebook of this protocol
metrics.faithfulness: MiniCheck roberta-large, sentence level, pinned and interpreted exactly as in tib-final523-faithfulness-261031-v1 (mean_prob and flagged_share; contract and S views); a different false-flag rate of MiniCheck on this model family is possible and is not measured here

analysis.cohort: C_applm: one cohort for every contrast and mean = IDs with a value for every metric of applm, led and bart (519 if no applm failure); a missing led/bart profile or metric is an error
analysis.bootstrap: stratified percentile bootstrap by source stratum, 10,000 resamples, seed 20261031, level 95% (tib_final523_analysis.bootstrap)
descriptive: per-profile means of rouge1_f1, rouge2_f1, rougeL_f1 and MiniCheck mean_prob/flagged_share on C_applm (tib_final523_applm.analyze)
applm only, from the generation receipt: delivered words, finish-reason histogram, no-terminal-EOS and repetition counts, failed rows, prompt/completion tokens, seconds
LED and BART lengths and EOS/repetition shares are taken from the existing final523 reports, not recomputed
analysis.no_label: no confirmed, selected or winner label; intervals are descriptive; no multiplicity adjustment
analysis.length_note: applm outputs are expected to be longer than BART and shorter than LED; the delivered word means are reported beside every contrast

options: keep the application's LLM and state the text-stage evidence as exploratory
change the application's text-stage model (needs its own plan: language, structure and multimodal input are outside this run)
add LED as an English first pass (needs its own plan)

budget.estimate: about 1.5-3 GPU hours for 523 summaries on a T4 if the plain AWQ kernels are fast enough; they may be slower (prefill up to about 27k tokens), which the projection after 20 records shows; plus about 0.5 GPU hour for MiniCheck
budget.stop_rule: every batch is checkpointed; after the first five batches (20 records in a fixed spread order over strata) the projected total is checked against the ceiling; the run stops before a batch would pass the ceiling and asks for more budget, never dropping records

receipts: applm_generation_receipt.json (counts, token counts, finish reasons, prompt sha256, decoding, timing, environment; no text)
applm_scores_receipt.json (ROUGE and MiniCheck per record; no text)
